what_this_is: Which files a session is actually sent to open, and which are only named in passing. The budget check charges what a skill or an agent definition sends a session to read, wherever in the repository that file lives. It does not try to work out from the wording which is which: a path written in backticks is either declared here as a file the session opens ('reads'), or declared as a file the text only names ('mentions'). A path that is in neither list fails the check.
why_declared_and_not_guessed: The two cases look identical to a machine. 'Read docs/X.md' and 'the reasoning is in docs/X.md' are the same shape. A check that guessed from the verb could be defeated by rewording the sentence, and nothing about what the session loads would change. A check that silently dropped what it could not classify would be under-counting, which is the dangerous direction. Refusing until somebody writes down which it is means a new pointer out of a skill can never slip through unnoticed - and writing 'this is only a mention' next to a large file is a visible act that a reviewer sees.
how_to_use_it: One entry per file that is charged to a session and names a path in backticks. Both lists hold paths exactly as they are written in the backticks. A path in 'reads' must exist, and a path ending in / is followed to every file inside it. A path in 'mentions' need not exist.

AGENTS.md.note: Every path AGENTS.md names, it names as a subject - what a file is, or where something is written down. It never tells a session to go and read one. Checked by grepping every occurrence.

.claude/agents/reviewer.md.note: 'Read docs/REVIEWER.md before you look at the change. That is the method, all of it.' Unconditional, for every reviewer session.

docs/REVIEWER.md.note: Sends the reviewer on to the precedents: 'Read it before you report.' The rest it names as sources and subjects.

.claude/skills/build/SKILL.md.note: The registry is read ('Look the id up in projects/registry.json ... It is the only place that address is read from'). .gitignore is opened to add a registered project's id to it. OPEN.md and PLAN.md are cited for where a decision or an assumption is written down, not handed to the session.

.claude/skills/virgil/SKILL.md.note: 'Read that file before answering anything about a project. Never from memory.' and 'Before designing anything that waits, read docs/SIGNALS.md'.

docs/SIGNALS.md.note: Names OPEN.md as the place that carries what has not been observed. A citation, not a handoff.
